name: NBHD Document Taint Guard
description: Instruction isolation + egress taint gate for uploaded documents/photos. Wraps pdf/image tool output in a treat-as-data boundary (tool_result_persist), blocks or logs calls to publish_portfolio_image/reddit/web_fetch on a document-tainted turn (before_tool_call), and emits hash-only injection-suspected telemetry. See docs/upload-security-threat-model.md P0-1/P0-2/P1-2.

mode.description: log_only: log what the exfil gate would have blocked but let the call proceed. enforce: hard-block the call. Default log_only.
